artworks.title: Untitled (Farmer's Daughter)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 522 x 346 mm (not including remarque)
sheet:  645 x 492 mm
plate:   575 x 390 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a young woman standing in an outdoor rural setting. She is in a relaxed position with her left hand on her hip and her right hand holding a wooden bucket. She wears a simple dress with puffed sleeves and a fitted bodice under a long apron that extends to her feet, in addition to a wide-brimmed hat. Her facial features are softly detailed, with a gentle expression, and her hair is tucked under her hat. The background features a stone wall, trees, a grassy field scattered with wildflowers, and a glimpse of a windmill structure.

artworks.title: In Low Tide
artworks.dimensions:
image: 341 x 282 mm
sheet:  440 x 378 mm
plate:   370 x 314 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a nautical scene with calm waters and a high horizon with a distant strip of land and buildings. A large sailing ship is positioned slightly right of center, with smaller vessels and buildings to the left. The style is detailed with fine lines and shading, giving a monochromatic, sepia-toned appearance. The water reflects the ships and the sky above.

artworks.title: Untitled (Two Girls at a Window)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 418 x 237 mm (not including remarque)
sheet:  542 x 352 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This image depicts two women by a large window. The woman on the left is standing, holding a rose near her face, while the woman on the right is seated, holding a book in her lap. The background shows a pastoral scene outside the window. The room has wooden accents.

artworks.title: Santa Barbara Mission
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a historic building to the right. The viewpoint is at ground level facing the structure and the terrain. The horizon is in the lower third of the image with a line of trees at the base of mountains. The mountains rise into the sky with swirling clouds above. The brushstrokes show detailed textures in the clouds and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing contrast and texture. A field with sheep is seen close by, with a path leading to the building on the right. The composition balances natural elements with the man-made structure.

artworks.title: Little Red Riding Hood
artworks.dimensions:
image: 251 x 192 mm
sheet:  397 x 283 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a child amidst a field of flowers with various scenes depicted above. In the bottom part of the image, there is a child surrounded by wildflowers, with detailed line work showing lush vegetation. The upper part displays smaller panels with different domestic and pastoral scenes. The top row shows a sleeping dog, a child in a bonnet, geese, and tranquil domestic settings. The etching evokes a nostalgic and rural atmosphere, capturing serene moments found in countryside life. The artwork uses shading and line work to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Cleveland, Ohio
artworks.dimensions:
plate:  180 x 254 mm
sheet:  217 x 310 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a townscape with buildings of various structures and designs, captured from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The composition is in a sketch style with fine, linear brushstrokes and a monochromatic palette in shades of sepia and black. The buildings are situated on a sloping terrain with some structures standing on stilts. Various buildings with different shapes and rooflines are seen in the distance, while the ground in the forefront is marked with light and shadow.

artworks.title: Merry Go Round, Coney Island
artworks.dimensions:
block:  203 x 292 mm
sheet:  310 x 460 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a carousel scene at an amusement park. The image features carousel horses with riders, as well as spectators. The carousel is decorated in a festive manner. The style of the drawing is bold and utilizes high contrast between black and white, creating a dynamic and lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: At the Spinning Wheel
artworks.dimensions:
plate:    379 x 252 mm
image:  347 x 236 mm
sheet:   566 x 413 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a doorway holding a thread and leaning on a spinning wheel. The person has short, curly hair and is dressed in a long garment. The spinning wheel sits on a striped rug on a wooden floor. In the background, there is a view through the open doorway with some trees and figures, along with a building to the side.

artworks.title: Rough Sport in the Yosemite
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows multiple horses being ridden by riders in a vast landscape with mountains in the background. The horses are in full gallop, depicted with their manes and tails flowing. The mountains are rugged and expansive, adding to the sense of wildness. The composition conveys a dynamic energy, likely depicting an action-packed moment.

artworks.title: The Reprimand
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing and an elderly man seated nearby. The woman is facing slightly to the right with her hands resting on her abdomen. She has wavy, shoulder-length hair, a solemn expression, and is wearing a high-collared dress with a shawl. The man has a full beard, prominent eyebrows, and is wearing a dark suit and a top hat while leaning forward on a chair. The setting is a rustic interior with a large fireplace on the right, a mantel displaying various items, and hanging objects on the walls.

artworks.title: Washing Morning Down South
artworks.dimensions:
plate:  220 x 349 mm
image:  186 x 324 mm
sheet:  391 x 502 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with various activities visible. The perspective is slightly elevated, capturing a broad view of the landscape. Trees, birds, agricultural work, buildings, and farmyard elements are depicted in fine detail using an etching technique. The color scheme is sepia and brown, giving the scene an aged look.

artworks.title: The Harbor, Bridgeport
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 111 x 169 mm
Sheet:  232 x 354 mm (left and right edges folded over)
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows several large boats docked along a harbor. The horizon is high in the composition, emphasizing the water and boats closest to the viewer. Distant buildings, more boats, and sails in the wind are visible along the horizon. Deliberate lines and cross-hatching are used for shading and texture, especially on the boats and water. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of black and gray, typical of an etching on paper that emphasizes details through contrast and line work.

artworks.title: The Gleaners
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 608 x 800 mm (false)
image: 543 x 747 mm
primary sheet: 585 x 774 mm
secondary sheet: 750 x 937 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with three women engaged in agricultural activities. One woman is kneeling, gathering crops, while another stands holding cut stalks. In the distance, a man and a woman stand with a rake. Hills and structures are visible on the horizon. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes and a sepia color palette, conveying a sense of tranquility and rural life.

artworks.title: Untitled (Crossing A Brook In The Woods)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 511 x 807 mm
sheet:  652 x 949 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows two females standing at the edge of a calm, shallow pond. The woman on the left is helping the young girl on the right across the water. The woman is standing on one leg in the water, wearing a long skirt and a dark jacket. The young girl is standing on a rock in the water, wearing a dress and a headband. They are surrounded by a wooded area with trees and bushes lining the pond.

artworks.title: New England Elms
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This image shows a street view captured at eye-level. The horizon is low and mostly obstructed by dense foliage of large trees lining the road, with some buildings faintly visible through the leaves. The etching technique creates detailed tree canopies blending into each other, forming a shaded canopy. The color palette is monochrome with varying shades of grey, giving a timeless feel and emphasizing light and shadow. The cobbled street is detailed with a rustic charm. In the distance, the street narrows under tree arches, inviting the viewer to explore further down the peaceful path.

artworks.title: George Henry Smillie (1840-1921)
artworks.dimensions:
plate:  263 x 149 mm
image:  215 x 124 mm
sheet:  347 x 275 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the knees upwards. He is standing in a three-quarter pose, slightly turned towards his left with his head facing forward. The man has a full, neatly groomed beard and a prominent mustache, with neatly combed hair that is receding slightly. He wears round glasses. His attire consists of a dark overcoat over a double-breasted suit, complete with a vest, shirt, and a tie or cravat. In his left hand, he holds a wide-brimmed hat and a pair of gloves. The backdrop of the image is a textured wall.

artworks.title: View of Gloucester, Mass.
artworks.dimensions:
image: 549 x  906 mm
sheet:  680 x 1019 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image presents a view of Gloucester, Massachusetts. In the foreground, there are lush shrubs and rocks with two people and a dog. Several small boats are in the water, along with a group of sailboats and ships. The town of Gloucester is visible in the background, with buildings densely packed together along the waterline. The sky above is cloudy, depicted in soft brushstrokes and a subdued grayscale. The overall color palette is sepia-toned.

artworks.title: Going Westward
artworks.artist: Stephen Alonzo Schoff, after M. F. H. de Haas
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene of a stormy ocean at night. The view is of choppy waves meeting a dark sky with ships visible in the distance. One ship is closer to the viewer, with its sails and masts silhouetted against the sky. Heavy clouds with a dim moon shining through them add to the atmosphere. The color palette is mainly deep grays and blacks with silvery moonlight highlights.

artworks.title: The Kitchen, New Orleans
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene with rustic architecture and an archway. The artwork captures a dimly lit interior with a large archway framing the view. Within the space, there are shadows playing across the textured walls and floor, adding depth to the scene. Objects such as a couple of buckets and a chair are scattered about. The light streaming through beyond the archway hints at an exterior bathed in brightness. The overall tone is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Hartford Bridge
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a large structure resembling a castle on the left. The horizon is in the upper half, lined with buildings and trees. A river flows through the lower part, with a wooden bridge crossing it. The scene is etched intricately, capturing reflections and textures. The color scheme is monochromatic sepia, emphasizing the historic feel.

artworks.title: Groton Monument
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 259 x 335 mm
Sheet: 353 x 452 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is low, highlighting the vast sky above. On the right, there are buildings surrounded by trees. In the center, there is a tall monument with a small structure at its base, slightly to the left. To the right of the monument, a person is standing. The drawing features detailed linework and delicate shading for the sky. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray. Rocks and grass in the foreground lead towards the monument and buildings in the distance.

artworks.title: Plainville, Conn. From The South West
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 348 x 556 mm
Sheet: 415 x 582 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of Plainville, Connecticut, from a southwest perspective. The horizon line is high, marking the transition from the foreground to the hills and buildings beyond. Hills span the width of the image, curving gently against the sky. Brushstrokes offer texture, especially in the trees and buildings. The color palette is monochromatic, in various shades of gray. Buildings, trees, and grazing cattle are visible in the foreground, leading to a more densely built town in the distance. The sky is soft with few clouds.

artworks.title: The Goldsmith's Daughter
artworks.dimensions:
image: 414 x 301 mm
sheet: 531 x 398 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up. She is positioned frontally with her head slightly turned to her left and looking straight ahead. She has large eyes, a straight nose, and full lips, with long, wavy hair tied back with a headband. She is wearing a gown with elaborate patterned sleeves, a frilled neckline, and holds a large vase with ornate reliefs of figures. She wears long, dangling earrings. The background features a detailed, cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Willow Whistle
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image features a young child seated on a tree branch, playing a wind instrument. The child is barefoot, dressed in a long-sleeved shirt and rolled-up pants. They have short, curly hair and appear focused on playing the instrument. The background shows tree branches and leaves against a pale sky. The image is done in a monochrome style.
